body:
This invocation exposes the synthesis response, the earlier account's commitments, and the objection set; the origin slot is absent. A coverage check shows the synthesis already sits downstream of both exposed inputs: every record of the account and the objection is adopted, revised, or dissolved inside it, with one silent drop (the async channel) that this carry makes explicit. The carry's job is therefore consolidation and status annotation, not redesign — keeping the synthesis as the standing account while pinning down what its parts now are.

What is retained, with grounds attached. The sequencing fix (private round before design meeting) rests on two independent derivations plus a cost asymmetry, and the redundancy is itself the ground: a later criticism has to beat both derivations, not one. The remedy set is diagnosis-agnostic — under-specification and ledger divergence receive the same written clarity, bounded disputes, and floor — so the four-week trial assays expectations and the success metric, not the remedies; the trial can fail to discriminate without invalidating any step, and only the reading of the dispute rate and the trigger for the terminal branch depend on its outcome. The dissolution of the specificity-versus-minimality tension via a bounded dispute venue is the load-bearing move that lets the record stay minimal; it should not be re-separated. Rotation (of both proposal authorship and the convening role) is what answers the fourth-chore problem, and the floor plus terminal branch are the only elements that survive total non-participation — that spine is participation-independent by construction, which is precisely why it stays.

Status changes recorded. The account's core diagnosis is demoted from diagnosis-in-hand to one of two co-possible hypotheses; the objection set's claim that it 'survives' remains true, but only in that weaker sense, since nothing exposed can choose between the two readings and the trial is the discriminator. The async written channel, half of the account's private-conversation step, was dropped without remark in the synthesis; this carry withdraws it as a default step on the objection's double-edge grounds (it can document silence as easily as engagement) while leaving it available as something the avoider could themselves choose from the menu. Triggers, p1-in-plenary, and the zero-disputes criterion stay rejected; the standards question stays answered by the gated common-floor rule.

The one defect this pass finds in the synthesis is internal: the design meeting lets the avoider choose first and runs whatever is chosen, yet the surrounding commitments specify the allocation, record, standards, outsourcing, and floor designs unconditionally. Either the choice is real and those designs are displaceable defaults, or they are fixed and the choosing is performative — and a detected performative choice corroborates exactly the rigged-process grievance the sequencing was rebuilt to avoid. The repair is an annotation, not a redesign: before the meeting, mark which elements are displaceable by the avoider's choice (the mechanism designs) and which are fixed invariants (trial expiry, the bounded dispute rule, the floor, the terminal branch).

Open problems carried unchanged: who delivers the private round if a two-against-one perception is live; the tally rule for three-party alternation (default per person, untested); whether the asker already knows what the avoider is avoiding — the absent origin settles nothing here and must not be read as evidence either way — and the qualitative-only status of the ledger finding. Proposed uptake for the next complete invocation: the synthesis commitment set as the operative plan, its claims and objections as grounds and constraints, the status annotation applied before any meeting is convened, and the four problems attached. Nothing in this carry requires discarding anything from the synthesis.
